basic_info.description: Welcome to 937 Judah Street, a charming lower-level full floor flat condo in the heart of vibrant San Francisco. This delightful 2-bedroom, 1&1/2 bath home offers a blend of classic charm and modern updates, making it the perfect urban retreat. Step inside to discover a beautifully renovated eat-in kitchen, thoughtfully updated with permits in 2015. The kitchen is equipped with all the essentials for culinary adventures and flows seamlessly into the formal dining room, perfect for hosting gatherings or enjoying intimate meals. The other side upon entry through the front door leads to the renovated bathroom (w permit), as well as two quiet bedrooms, each offering a serene escape with views of the large shared backyard, ideal for relaxation or entertaining friends. Convenience is key with a washer and dryer in the unit's laundry room, making laundry day a breeze. The home also includes a garage with tandem parking, providing ample space for your vehicles.  Ample shared storage in the garage with the upper condo. Situated in a prime location, you'll have easy access to major highways, making commuting a breeze. Plus, the N-Judah line is right in front of the property, offering seamless connectivity to the city's vibrant offerings. Don't miss the chance to experience the best of SF.
